newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet weakens as NYMEX extends heat selloff.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet weakens as NYMEX extends heat selloff.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices slid lower Tuesday as NYMEX No. 2 oil extended its losses and differentials on the Gulf Coast weakened slightly.
NYMEX heating oil remained under pressure because of relatively soft demand and ample supplies in the U.S. Northeast, according to traders.
U.S. Gulf (USG) prompt 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 2.75 cents under the screen, down about 0.10 cent on the day but slighlty up from earlier Tuesday levels.
Prompt USG 55-grade barrels were bid near 2.00 cents under the NYMEX, though few offers were seen.
